content.short: Quantstamp is a world-class security firm providing audited assurance for high-profile TON protocols and dApps.
content.description: Quantstamp is a global leader in blockchain security, having secured over $200 billion in digital asset value. It provides professional security services for projects on the TON blockchain, specializing in smart contract audits and security architecture design. Quantstamp's team of world-class security researchers and engineers works closely with TON developers to identify critical vulnerabilities and ensure that their protocols meet the highest standards of safety and reliability, making it a trusted partner for the most ambitious projects in the ecosystem.
content.meta: Trust your security to Quantstamp, the global leader in blockchain audits. Secured projects on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
